name: What is the typical process for a multi-room interior renovation with City Dweller, LLC?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical process for a multi-room interior renovation with City Dweller, LLC?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our process begins with an initial consultation to understand your vision, needs, and budget. Next, we develop a detailed proposal, including scope of work, timeline, and cost estimate. Upon agreement, we assist with design, material selection, and securing necessary permits from local authorities in cities like Pacifica or Daly City. Construction then commences with our experienced team, followed by regular communication and quality checks. The project concludes with a final walkthrough and any necessary adjustments to ensure your complete satisfaction.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our process involves consultation, proposal, design, permitting, construction, and a final walkthrough, ensuring your vision is realized with clear communication.
